title: Human medial temporal lobe iEEG during a visual working memory task (Boran et al.; DANDI 000575)
description: Intracranial EEG recordings from medial temporal lobe depth electrodes (amygdala, hippocampus, entorhinal and parahippocampal cortex) in patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a visual working memory change-detection task with set sizes of 1, 2, 4 or 6 items. This BIDS-iEEG derivative represents the continuous iEEG series released in NWB format on DANDI (000575), with corrected sampling rates, amplitude units, MNI electrode coordinates and trial, period and response events. Single-unit data remain in the source NWB files.
methods_description: Recordings were made with a Neuralynx ATLAS system at the University Hospital Zurich during invasive monitoring. Data were exported by the authors via FieldTrip to NWB, and then converted to BIDS-iEEG (BrainVision, float32 microvolts) without filtering, resampling or re-referencing. Sampling rates were verified from the 50 Hz mains peak and from coverage of trial times.
